name: George Martelli Tsuchiya
source:
George M. Tsuchiya is the son of Takeshi Tsuchiya, the head of a continent publishing firm in NuNew York. He enrolled in Fuji Academy in 2089, shortly after his father remarried Eriko Li, heiress to the Solar Power empire. He was expelled from the academy in 2091.

The protagonist meets him while waiting for his/her philosophy class partner in the gardens.
